run_experiment_with_config: run a BenchMarkML experiment using ExperimentConfig loaded from YAML with MAPPO algorithm and MLP model
configure_experiment_checkpoints: configure an ExperimentConfig to checkpoint at every iteration by setting checkpoint_interval to on_policy_collected_frames_per_batch
restore_experiment_from_checkpoint: restore an experiment from a saved checkpoint file by setting restore_file on ExperimentConfig
create_experiment_with_task: create an Experiment with a VMAS task, MAPPO algorithm config, and MLP model config
evaluate_experiment: evaluate a BenchMarkML experiment after running it by calling experiment.evaluate
